subject: Token unit economics and sign-off path
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@novata.io>, Novata Procurement <procurement@novata.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-09T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Token unit economics and sign-off path

Hi Elena / Novata team,

Thanks again for the call this morning — good clarity on anticipated volumes and success signals. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on who needs to sign and roughly what budget band we should be planning for.

Key takeaways from our discovery:
- Expected steady-state: ~5–8M tokens/month; peak cadence could hit 12M in promotional months.
- Primary workload: short chat completions + embeddings for search (mix skews toward generation).
- Success metric: sub-150ms median token latency for production endpoints and a <5% QoQ cost delta target.

Unit economics we sketched on the call:
- Target $/1M tokens for initial commercial engagement: $1,250 (tiered discounts apply above 10M/mo).
- Estimated monthly spend (baseline): $6,250–$10,000 for 5–8M tokens. Peak: ~ $15,000 for a 12M month.

Who signs and who pays? This is the part I wanted to lock down:
- Economic buyer (who approves spend): Elena Rossi (you mentioned you own analytics tooling budgets?) — please confirm.
- Finance approver: procurement@novata.io or finance@novata.io ?
- Budget owner (where line item will be booked): product ops / platform — confirm name/owner so we can put it on the MAP.

Proposed next steps:
1) If you confirm the economic buyer and finance approver, I’ll share a short pricing worksheet and a 1-page mutual action plan (attached).
2) We’ll propose a pilot agreement for the first 90 days with the $/1M target above and a rollback clause for quality regressions.
3) Marissa will schedule a procurement check call if Novata wants legal/contract redlines early.

Attaching: RDW_pricing_estimate_1M_tokens_v1.xlsx and a draft MAP.

Can you confirm the three roles (econ buyer, finance approver, budget owner) so we can move the MAP to the right people?

Thanks,
Markus

--
Markus Klein
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@novata.io>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Novata Procurement <procurement@novata.io>
Date: 2026-11-09T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Token unit economics and sign-off path

Thanks Markus — good summary. A couple of clarifying questions before I loop finance: 

1) That $1,250 / 1M tokens figure — is that BYO model-with-quantization pricing or does that assume your hosted SKU and standard latency SLOs? We need to map to our internal chargeback model.
2) On discounts above 10M/mo, can you outline the banding (10–20M, 20–50M)?
3) For budget ownership: I own the analytics tooling budget nominally, but formal approval often needs sign-off from our Head of Platform (Ravi Patel) and Finance (finance@novata.io).

If you can send a simple table (SKU / $ per 1M / expected latency SLO / recommended deployment type) I can get procurement and finance on a 15–20 minute call tomorrow.

Elena

Elena Rossi
Director, Analytics Platform | Novata Analytics
elena.rossi@novata.io | +44 20 7946 0821

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@novata.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-10T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Token unit economics and sign-off path

Elena — perfect, thanks for the clarity. Answers inline and attached a one-row SKU table to make procurement's life easier.

1) The $1,250 / 1M tokens is for our hosted inference SKU (standard latency SLO ~120–200ms depending on prompt length) — includes basic KV caching and production support. If you prefer a private/dedicated deployment we can improve unit cost but that requires a committed capacity contract and longer lead time.

2) Banding (high level):
- 5–10M/mo: $1,250 / 1M
- 10–25M/mo: $1,050 / 1M
- 25–50M/mo: $900 / 1M
(we can do custom bands for >50M)

3) Noted on approval flow: please loop Ravi Patel and finance@novata.io. For the MAP, we recommend listing Elena as Economic Buyer, Ravi as Budget Owner, and finance@novata.io as Finance Approver — is that correct?

Attached: RDW_pricing_estimate_1M_tokens_v1.xlsx (SKU row with the three bands) and mutual_action_plan_novata.pdf (draft timeline: pilot -> production -> committed capacity).

Proposed short agenda for procurement call (15 min):
- Quick intro + confirm bands and target $/1M
- Sign-off path and PO timing
- Any compliance/contract items legal wants early

If procurement is available tomorrow at 11:00 PT we can run through it; otherwise propose 09:00 or 14:00. Marissa, can you slot this?

Thanks — will stand by to update the MAP once Elena confirms the three roles.

Best,
Markus

--
